prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a cloudy, foggy night sky. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the sandy beach bordered by dense vegetation on the left and gentle waves lapping at the shore on the right. As the viewer progresses, the dim ambient light reveals scattered rocks and patches of seaweed on the sand, enhancing the natural texture of the terrain. The camera angle remains consistent, offering a clear view of the horizon where the dark clouds blend seamlessly with the night. The surrounding environment is quiet and devoid of people, emphasizing the solitude of the scene. Gradually, the path veers slightly towards the vegetation, leading into a darker area where the light becomes even more subdued, casting deep shadows among the trees. The camera continues its steady advance, navigating through the underbrush, with occasional glimpses of the beach still visible through gaps in the foliage. The overall atmosphere is serene yet mysterious, with the muted colors and soft lighting contributing to the tranquil yet enigmatic ambiance of the nighttime beach setting.
